name: SendEmail
caption: Send Email

configuration.description: ID of the Business Central email account to send from (Email Accounts page), as a GUID string without braces. Environment-specific: re-pick it after importing into another environment.
Ordinal of Business Central's 'Email Connector' enum for the account (which connectors exist depends on the installed email apps). Unknown ordinals fall back to the enum's default value.
Display text only, '<account name> (<email address>)'. Not read at run time.
Recipient addresses separated by ';' or ','. SmartFields resolved at run time.
Subject line. Required in the dialog; not checked at run time.
HTML body (rich-text editor). SmartFields resolved at run time. Always sent as HTML.

Array of attachment rows {type, reference, filename, contentBase64}. type 'Reference' (default when empty/unknown; compared case-insensitively): 'reference' is a {{selector}} to an AutoFlow Document reference, an array of them, an iterator over them, or 'name[N]' for one array element; each document becomes one attachment. type 'Inline': 'filename' + 'contentBase64' (both SmartText); the content type is guessed from the file extension.
Row type. Stored values are 'Reference' and 'Inline'; matched case-insensitively at run time, anything else is treated as Reference.
Reference rows: {{selector}} pointing to AutoFlow Document reference(s) (table 5564415). Ignored for Inline rows.
Inline rows: file name incl. extension. Ignored for Reference rows (the document's Name is used, or 'document_<ID>' when empty).

rules.check: 'To' is a required field in the configuration dialog
'Subject' is a required field in the configuration dialog
configuration.attachments, if present, must be an array of objects (a non-object row fails the editor validation)
rules.message: (no message text; the step is reported as invalid)

rules.check: Each Inline row must have non-empty filename and contentBase64 (checked when the dialog is saved, and again at run time)
rules.message: Inline attachment is missing a filename or content.

rules.check: Each Reference row must have a non-empty reference (checked when the dialog is saved, and again at run time)
A Reference row's selector must use {{name}} notation (dialog save, live status line, run time)
rules.message: Attachment reference selector '%1' must use the SmartField placeholder notation, e.g. '{{name}}'.

rules.check: A Reference row's selector (with a trailing [N] stripped) must resolve to an output available at this step (dialog save, live status line); at run time it must exist in the run context / array must have element N
rules.message: Attachment reference selector "%1" was not found in the available outputs.

rules.check: A Reference row's selector must point to a record reference or an array of references, not a value (dialog save, live status line, run time)
rules.message: Attachment reference selector "%1" must point at a record reference (or array of references).

rules.check: A Reference row's selector must point to records of the AutoFlow Document table (5564415) (dialog save, live status line, run time)
rules.message: Attachment reference selector "%1" must point at a record from the AutoFlow Document table; got table %2.

rules.check: After resolution (and after a test-mode redirect) at least one of to/cc/bcc must be non-empty
rules.message: At least one recipient (To, CC, or BCC) is required.

rules.check: Every resolved address in to/cc/bcc must pass Business Central's email address check
accountId must be a non-empty GUID of an email account registered for accountConnector
rules.message: The configured email account is no longer registered or active.

rules.check: Each referenced AutoFlow Document must still exist
rules.message: Document record %1 referenced by selector "%2" no longer exists.

rules.check: Inline contentBase64 must be valid base64
rules.message: Inline attachment content is not valid base64-encoded data.

notes: No publish-time check exists for this step. The attachment checks run when the step is saved in the configuration dialog (and as a live status line), and again at run time.

Test mode: when AutoFlow Setup has test mode active with test e-mail recipients, all To/CC/BCC recipients are replaced by the test recipients (in To; CC and BCC cleared) and the execution log notes the redirect.
sentEmailId is the email message GUID (no braces), the same identifier Business Central shows as the Sent Email message id.
accountId/accountConnector are environment-specific. A definition moved to another environment must have them re-selected, otherwise the step fails at run time.

Inline attachment content is decoded from base64 into text before being written as the attachment; byte-exact transfer of binary files (PDF, images) via Inline rows is not guaranteed. For binary files prefer a Reference row to an AutoFlow Document (e.g. from Create PDF or Azure Blob: Get file). This is inferred from the code path, not documented behaviour.
Sending uses Business Central's standard email module (Email.Send); a send failure raises the platform's error.
